title: longfellow-vectors mdoc credential vector, v1
description: Sidecar for IssuerSigned CBOR under vectors/mdoc/credentials/: {nameSpaces, issuerAuth}, the structure an issuer delivers. Not a DeviceResponse, and it carries no device signature.

doctype.description: DocType read from the MSO inside issuerAuth; IssuerSigned carries no docType of its own. Present only when the CBOR parsed as IssuerSigned and the MSO decoded at write time.

device_key.description: Vector name of the credential's device key. Present only when the key vector's public half matched the deviceKeyInfo of the MSO inside the top-level issuerAuth at write time.

ds_certificate.description: Vector name of the credential's document-signer certificate. Present only when the certificate's bytes matched the x5chain leaf of the top-level issuerAuth at write time.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sibling .cbor file's bytes.
